summary: Prove the Wave 1 exit path OFFLINE against the loopback fixture gateway: remote-config push_enabled + updateRequired, a G1TestPushProvider that posts its token to the fixture and a push data.url that resolves through resolveLink, and every LINK_PATHS universal link resolving through resolve-link / link-router / auth-port. Adds only the test provider plus the g1-smoke suites; no existing module is modified and the production default push provider stays Noop.
